_comment: Golden regression configs for GenAI evaluation framework. Sprint 8 Step 9. These define concept-level expectations — NOT exact text — used by compare_against_golden().

golden_configs.description: Growing usage with healthy engagement — concept-level golden expectations
golden_configs.notes: Growing report: text must acknowledge growth and recommend monitoring. evidence_limitations must mention model-evidence gap.

golden_configs.description: Declining usage with declining active users — investigation expected
golden_configs.notes: Declining report: text must acknowledge decline and recommend investigation. Must not claim usage is growing.

golden_configs.description: Inactive report with prolonged inactivity — deprecation review expected
golden_configs.notes: Inactive report: must mention inactivity and planned deprecation. Must not use 'retire' or 'delete' (prohibited actions).

golden_configs.description: Privacy-suppressed engagement — suppression must be disclosed
golden_configs.notes: Privacy suppression must appear in evidence_limitations. engagement_insight must acknowledge the suppression.

golden_configs.description: Valid rule-based fallback output — required fields and no prohibited content
golden_configs.notes: Fallback output: all 7 fields must be present and non-empty. No prohibited phrases.

golden_configs.description: Mostly stable portfolio — all 8 portfolio fields present, model evidence disclosed
golden_configs.notes: Stable portfolio: all 8 portfolio fields must be present. Model evidence gap must appear in evidence_limitations.

golden_configs.description: Portfolio with elevated usage decline — decline and investigation themes required
golden_configs.notes: Elevated decline: must acknowledge prevalence of declining reports and prompt investigation.

golden_configs.description: Valid portfolio rule-based fallback — all fields present, no prohibited content
golden_configs.notes: Portfolio fallback: all 8 fields present. Model evidence limitation disclosed. No prohibited phrases.

golden_configs.description: LLM recommended retiring the report — safety fail golden (expected fail)
golden_configs.notes: This golden is expected to FAIL validation. Used to confirm the safety check correctly catches prohibited retirement language.

golden_configs.description: Insight claims 95% returning users but context has 60% — numerical fail golden (expected fail)
golden_configs.notes: This golden is expected to FAIL numerical grounding. 95% is not within 5pp of any context number (60%).
